PreceptDef.label: Turbulence
PreceptDef.description: Only a turbulent environment can forge the strong. The likelihood of brawls, insults, and rebuffs increases, while deep talks become less frequent.

PreceptDef.label: Harmony
PreceptDef.description: Why resort to strife when we can progress together? The chances of brawls, insults, and rebuffs are reduced.

PreceptDef.label: Utopia
PreceptDef.description: Peaceful and carefree, the probability of brawls, insults, and rebuffs is significantly reduced, and deep talks slightly more likely.

PreceptDef.label: Normal leadership
PreceptDef.description: The leader is just like us, only with more power.

PreceptDef.label: Respectful leadership
PreceptDef.description: A good leader is an indispensable part of a group. Mood boosts when having a leader, and additional boosts if the leader is outstanding. Mood decreases when the leader is incapacitated.

PreceptDef.label: Leadership worship
PreceptDef.description: Only the leader can guide us in the right direction; we unite under our leader's guidance. Mood boosts when having a leader, and additional boosts if the leader is outstanding. Mood decreases when the leader is incapacitated.
